evidence_dependencies: Before locking, simulate removal of the consent instrument: the strongest surviving argument is a retained minute or independent confirmation affirmatively recording that the exact named holder gave qualifying personal consent to the exact decision. Credit that passage with the necessary authority and decision passages if sufficient. A statement that payment was cleared, without a scoped attestation, is not equivalent. Masking the instrument then removes at most one route; a proper fact deletion must also remove all attestations of that same qualifying consent.

Simulate removal of the trustee decision: a signed consent incorporating an authenticated decision or a minute independently attesting the exact effective trustee act may still prove it. Credit that route; a reference to a recommendation or a draft cannot establish the act. Simulate removal of the governing requirement: a verified restatement or a sufficiently self-contained operative record may preserve the positive edge. Approve that subset and revise the mask expectation; return the design if the two-act distinction is dispensable.

Fresh readers verify the strongest singleton and short combinations before declaring necessity. Attach exact body passages identifying the trust or its explicit reference, named designee, both actual exercises, the capacity used in each, and the applicable effect terms. Include attribution and framing when a signature or reference would otherwise be ambiguous. Verify the exact basis for withholding in each diagnostic without emitting a negative edge. Independently rederive the full key after each change.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: The full graph contains the beneficiary and separately supported office. With only the trustee act established, the personal act remains unestablished rather than refused; with only the personal act established, there is no demonstrated trustee designation. These are expected results of properly deleting the propositions, not assumptions about what any one Source mask removes.
genres_and_provenance: The trustees supply the verified governing extract and the separately executed current appointment instrument from their retained papers. They establish the rule, the expressly named personal power holder and the independent basis of office.

The secretary retains the trustees' signed substantive decision and the native request for separate personal consent. The decision identifies the actual trustee action, named provision and decision reference; the request accounts for obtaining the separate act.

The holder's signed personal consent is retained as received in the decision file. A subsequent implementation minute or instruction to proceed is retained by the trustees for execution and accountability; keep whatever the latter actually attests.

The accounts workstream retains the authorised payment instruction, the provider's native processing confirmation and the accountant's reconciliation. These document authorisation to pay, actual processing and accounting treatment for distinct purposes.
The adviser retains a dated review brief fixing the scope and cut-off without giving the key.
design.intervention: Score one intact natural condition. Use separate, review-only proper deletions of the personal exercise, the collective decision and the operative two-act requirement, including copies or derivations of the deleted fact. Separately mask the accounts and provider material as a negative control. Do not alter a signature capacity or retroactively create an unsigned sibling.
invariants: The person, trust, two live capacities, chronology and cut-off agree across the complete file. Ordinary current office and any unaffected provision have independently sufficient support.
Deleting the evidence of an exercise does not change an actor's underlying capacity. A receipt, request, payment instruction or posting retains its own documentary meaning.
negative_controls: The strongest false route is the dual holder's genuine signature in the trustee decision. Exact decision-body wording and signer attribution establish the capacity used there; the governing text establishes why that signature is not the separate exercise.

A request for consent and a provider confirmation of processing do not attest its exercise. Masking purely financial implementation records leaves independently supported office and beneficiary proof intact.
design.scenario: Use a first routine governance-and-accounts review after a completed decision cycle. Both acts concern the same exact proposed provision, but neither participation as trustee nor possession of a personal power establishes that the other act took place.
shortcut_heuristics: Test any-signature, double-count-one-signature, consent-as-designation and paid-means-beneficiary rules. Check that a correct edge is not paired with proof of the wrong capacity.
Audit subject lines, filenames, source order, copied resolution text, standing-authority summaries and any chronological wrapper for leaked results or overlooked sufficient routes.
success_criteria: Two isolated readers each reconstruct the complete exact-name graph from all Sources. Fresh readers verify sufficient subsets and rederive complete diagnostic keys without seeing the expected result. The bidirectional audit accounts for every apparent exercise and both positive relationships.

Stop if one ordinary combined instrument is the natural record and separation would be artificial, if an ordinarily available confirmation makes exercise in the actual capacity immaterial, or if the conclusion depends on a rule not supplied in the file.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and integration 13–19; isolated whole-file and fresh excerpt or removal review 11–17; adjudication and audit 8–12; owner realism review 3–5. Assumes one trust, one decision cycle, two complete reads and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 10 natural Sources. Count the governing extract, appointment, decision, request, consent, implementation record, payment instruction, provider confirmation, reconciliation and brief only if each is made and retained for a separate task in this cycle.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse A's operative-route checks, B's provenance tracing and C's complete-graph, same-edge sufficient-subset and independent rederivation checks.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Score beneficiary_of, trustee_of and independently supported ordinary relationships. Personal powers, acts of consent, approval and implementation stay in the evidence or companion register; neither unresolved authority nor an unproven relationship is a negative edge.
risks_and_limits: This is not a causal estimate of the effect of adding a consent record or a claim about real trust powers.

An express capacity statement may make classification easy; report any lexical shortcut separately from complete proof recovery. Do not pad the file or withhold a conclusive normal record to preserve a longer route.

assumptions: The supplied operative terms expressly permit the same person to hold both capacities, identify the holder, and say that the trustees' eligible decision and a separate written personal consent to that decision are both required. They state when the combination takes effect and require no inference from general law or payment.

Separate consent has an ordinary governance reason and is actually made and retained separately, not manufactured by splitting one normal instrument. The pack includes ordinary recitals, close-out evidence and independent confirmations available by the cut-off, whether or not they shorten the proof.
grounding.documentary_situation: One individual is both a current trustee and the separately named holder of a personal consent power. The individual participates in the valid collective trustee decision and separately gives the personal consent to that particular decision. The two acts are expressly distinct. Accounts and provider records document implementation, not a new designation.
grounding.legal_workflow: Review an effective named provision and reconcile the trustee decision trail with the resulting implementation and accounts records.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Establish the current named provision and office roster; distinguish the acts authorising the provision from the records implementing it.
practitioner_unknowns: Would this arrangement naturally keep distinct records of the two acts, and would the implementation record itself ordinarily attest both with sufficient scope?
Would the advice file need both the governance and accounts trails at this review without an already available, independently sufficient current provision record?

references.relevance: Grounds retaining instruments, trustee decisions, minutes and payment records. It does not establish a dual-capacity power, a consent formalism or the effect of either act.
references.title: HMRC · Records to keep for trusts

grounding.retainer: Trust administration advice on a named provision for which the trustees' decision requires a separate exercise of a personal consent power.

objective.coverage_gap: AA asks whether distinct eligible voters assented to the same decision; it cannot diagnose substitution of one act for another by the very same person, even when the collective decision is unquestionably valid in its own capacity. AQ distinguishes representation of another principal from personal office. Here both capacities really belong to one person, and each is actually exercised under a different requirement.
objective.failure_mechanism: An extractor may count trustee participation as personal consent, treat the personal consent as the designation itself, or recover the right beneficiary but attach only signatures, a generic approval or an implementation record.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The intact file licenses the named beneficiary and the continuing trustee office, with the designation supported through both legally distinct acts under the express terms. Exact complete recovery with any verified sufficient attachment disconfirms the predicted errors on this file. If either act is independently sufficient under the retained terms, or the records do not distinguish the capacities actually used, the proposed mechanism is not verified.

proposals.title: A trustee's vote does not supply their separately required personal consent

evidence_dependencies: Simulate founding-document removal first. The strongest surviving route is a recital in the addition instrument or a verified founding extract expressly identifying the exact founder, trust and completed declaration. Credit a self-contained recital or linked subset if sufficient. A carried opening balance or unverified reported label alone cannot recover the deleted act. Masking one appearance cannot establish proposition-level absence.

Simulate removal of the addition attribution or same-trust link. An expressly adopted closing confirmation or independently verified reconciliation may still identify the second person as settling the property on that same trust, rather than sending it. Credit its exact named, scoped attestation and any linkage passages; revise the removal key accordingly. If the body of the addition gives the exact trust independently, do not insist on another documentary identifier.

Fresh excerpt readers test singletons and strong short subsets. Quote the body passages that distinguish each completed act, each exact endpoint and the actual role. Use joint proof only where needed. When testing passage-specific absence, remove the scoped assertion and all equivalent restatements only in the diagnostic, keeping unrelated recitals intact. Independently rederive each complete key, including any surviving proof.
design.expected_sensitivity_or_invariance: Recover two settlor edges to the same trust, each with its own sufficient proof. If a proper deletion removes all sufficient support for one named act, the other edge remains. If removal of a linkage fact leaves the trust endpoint unresolved, do not invent another trust or infer that the addition did not occur.
genres_and_provenance: Two operative Sources retained by the trustees: the executed declaration for the opening property and the completed instrument of addition for the later property. Each records its own act and maker.

The original valuer's dated report retained with the opening accounts and the later contributor's instruction retained by the provider serve valuation and transaction handling respectively; an instruction alone does not establish completion.
The provider retains and supplies its posting advice and a separate period holdings statement, for confirmation of the actual movement and period reporting respectively.

The accountant retains the property reconciliation distinguishing opening and added property. The reporting administrator retains a dated reporting snapshot and a native query about reconciling particulars. Preserve what these records actually derive or independently attest.
The adviser retains the dated briefing note stating the cut-off and separate substantive and accounting questions.
design.intervention: Score one intact natural condition. In review only, separately remove the founding settlor proposition and the later completed-settlement attribution with their copies; test the explicit same-trust link separately. Mask records that merely report valuation and balances. Do not edit the transfer or declaration to manufacture a scored sibling.
invariants: One continuing trust, two distinct acts, two exact names and one cut-off in the intact file. Independently supported office and other ordinary relationships retain their own proof.
Property records remain useful for reconciling holdings without thereby conferring or denying any scored role.
negative_controls: The exact founding body text affirmatively establishes the declaration and its subject property; no absence of a bank credit is needed to establish it. The completed addition text establishes which trust receives the further settlement without displacing the founding act.

The posted movement and provider statement establish financial facts, not a settlor merely by account name. Reporting material must not substitute for the operative proof unless the supplied record independently attests the relevant act with sufficient scope.
design.scenario: The adviser reconciles opening property and an actual subsequent addition against operative and financial records at one cut-off. Both are genuine settlements under the supplied terms. The provider trail describes the added property but does not explain the constituting declaration or convert its missing transfer into evidence of non-settlement.
shortcut_heuristics: Test inbound-credit-only, one-settlor-per-trust, newest-instrument-only, one-trust-per-deed and reported-name rules. Verify that a correct graph is not supported by an exchange of the two people's proof passages.
Audit body references, headings, filenames, provider labels, Source order and derived roster text for answer leakage, mistaken trust joins or an omitted shorter proof.
success_criteria: Two isolated whole-file readers recover every exact-name edge. Fresh readers verify both positive bases, the insufficiency of route-specific administrative cues, the strongest surviving subsets and independently rederived diagnostic keys.

Stop if a split dossier must be invented solely to hit the inventory, if one supposed settlor is just an administrative or deemed label, or if ordinary material collapses the proposed mechanism into a bare roster with no separately ascertainable operative bases. Do not exclude ordinary earlier authorised records.

feasibility.authoring_and_review_effort: Estimated person-hours: authoring and integration 12–18; isolated whole-file and fresh excerpt or removal review 11–16; adjudication and audit 8–12; owner realism review 3–5. Assumes one trust, one later addition, two complete reads and at most one pre-lock revision.
feasibility.documentary_complexity: Nominal 10 natural Sources. The two instruments, opening valuation, later instruction, posting advice, holdings statement, property reconciliation, reporting snapshot, native query and advice brief serve distinct operative, financial or reporting purposes.
feasibility.infrastructure_reuse: Reuse exact trust linkage and full-graph checks from C, provenance checks from B and the existing same-edge sufficient-subset and independently rederived mask-key checks.
feasibility.ontology_compatibility: Use distinct Person endpoints, one exact Trust endpoint, settlor_of and independently supported ordinary predicates. Property, transaction details and reporting discrepancies remain in evidence or the companion register.
risks_and_limits: This is not a general definition of settlor or a causal test of receiving a financial record.

The decisive filed statements may be lexically easy. The marginal test is preserving both correctly evidenced edges despite unlike operative and financial histories, not making either statement hard to find.

assumptions: The operative Sources expressly identify the two distinct settlors and the actual settled property, and establish same-trust continuity and completed effect. Use the file's express accounts of the acts, not an inference about ownership, tax deeming, implied resettlement or the validity of declarations under external law.

Both property workstreams are genuinely relevant to the same first reconciliation after the addition. Include any complete founding recital, addition acknowledgement or verified current schedule ordinarily available at that point.
grounding.documentary_situation: The executed founding instrument records one person declaring already-held property subject to the named trust, without a corresponding inbound transfer. Another person later adds distinct property by a completed operative instrument and actual transfer. The addition expressly applies to the existing trust and records the second settlement without substituting for or amending the founding act.
grounding.legal_workflow: Reconcile the operative property papers, investment trail and reported particulars of a continuing trust after a separately documented addition.
grounding.meeting_purpose: Identify who is affirmatively recorded as settling each body of property on the same trust, separately from reconciling balances and reporting entries.
practitioner_unknowns: Would the added property naturally be documented in a separate effective instrument that affirmatively identifies the adding settlor without constituting a different trust?

Would opening valuation evidence and the later provider and reporting records ordinarily be assembled together for this review? Would normal confirmations already settle both relationships and their bases?

references.relevance: Grounds retention of instruments, valuations, investment information and accounts in a reconciliation. It does not establish who settles property or the effect of an addition.

references.relevance: Grounds the reporting snapshot as a record of information held for reporting. Its basis and any evidentiary limits must be established in the supplied file.

grounding.retainer: Trust records and accounts advice on the sources of opening and subsequently settled property before updating reported particulars.

objective.coverage_gap: BF, the closest settlor case, distinguishes the settlor from the remitter and fee payer in one closing allocation. It cannot test recovery of two genuine settlors of one continuing trust when one act is an express declaration without an incoming movement and the other is an effective addition with actual movement. BG keeps two trusts distinct during an asset transfer and does not supply this cumulative single-trust settlor test.
objective.failure_mechanism: A system may treat every settlor as the sender of an inbound transfer, replace the founder with the later settlor, invent a new trust for the addition, or cite only a posting or reported label for an otherwise correct settlor edge.
objective.falsifiable_hypothesis: The intact file licenses both named settlor relationships to the same exact trust, through distinct operative bases. Exact full recovery with a sufficient subset attached to each edge disconfirms the predicted errors on this file. Reject the mechanism if both roles rely on the same cash trail, the addition is actually a replacement or a separate trust, or the roles require outside legal inference.

stopping_criteria: Before construction, justify each Source by its creator, distinct job, custody and ordinary availability at the cut-off. Stop or narrow if the records require artificial splitting, unrecorded knowledge or omission of a normally available controlling record.

Preflight each planned deletion against the strongest surviving direct assertion, independently transmitted record and accurate derivative. Register sufficient alternatives before lock. A lost passage is not a lost fact; a lost route is not necessarily a lost edge. Change or discard any unsupported absence prediction.

Require two genuinely isolated complete-file reconstructions and fresh exact-excerpt and diagnostic readers. Verify both graph-to-file and file-to-graph coverage, with all necessary passages of one sufficient subset on the correct edge. If disagreement survives the allowed revision, return the candidate and preserve the failed result.

Keep development fictional, local and within the supplied-text Person/Trust contract. Do not commission large, giant, real-client, sealed or held-out work, or substitute section-level keys for an intact full-context read. Do not promote a technical qualification or proposal to human admission.
